lines.text: In nineteen twenty-five, a con man sold the Eiffel Tower.
See, he'd read that the tower was rusting,
and that Paris was paying a fortune to fix it,
so he sent forged letters to scrap dealers, pretending to be a government official.
He invited them to a private meeting at a fancy hotel,
where one nervous dealer handed over a suitcase of cash.
and the dealer was too embarrassed to call the police.
So he came back and tried it again,
but this time he got spooked, and fled to America.
And yes, the tower is still standing.
